{
  "name": "briefpay",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.13.0"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "install:ci": "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile",
    "judge:demo": "node scripts/judge-demo.mjs",
    "dev": "node scripts/run-framework.mjs dev",
    "build": "node scripts/run-framework.mjs build",
    "start": "node --import ./scripts/sites-env.mjs ./node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev --config dist/server/wrangler.json --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --ip 127.0.0.1 --inspector-port 0",
    "lint": "eslint . --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern .next",
    "db:generate": "drizzle-kit generate",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.ts tests/booking-lab.test.mjs tests/booking-policy-backend.test.mjs tests/runtime-policy-backend.test.mjs tests/seller-staging.test.mjs tests/seller-staging-hosted.test.mjs tests/seller-capacity-staging.test.mjs"
